settings.title: Discover the Argentine Tango shoe collection
settings.text: Bloch’s all-new Argentine Tango shoe collection was crafted with the expert guidance of internationally acclaimed Argentine Tango dancer and choreographer Maria Tsiatsiani. Each style rigorously trialled and tested over a year, resulting in an exceptional collection, where refined elegance meets technical innovation.
The collection features three standout styles—Malena, Ayres, and Poema— available in a refined colour palette of black, red, sand and champagne, in a glitter or patent finish.

settings.title: Refined elegance meets technical innovation
settings.text: The finest Argentine Tango shoe on the market: a blend of Bloch's 90 years of footwear innovation and design, along with Maria's dedication to excellence.

settings.title: 3.5 inch flared heel
settings.text: This shoe has a round tip and flared heel for better stability than typical square-cut Tango heels, grounded with a leather outsole for superior glide and pivots. Perfect for dancers of all levels.

settings.title: Precision without compromising on style
settings.text: The Ayres and Poema styles feature a soft PU panel that moulds to your foot, with a gorgeous glitter vamp, whilst the Poema‘s elegant embellishments offer a stunning finish. Alternatively, choose the elegantly understated Malena in high-gloss patent for a refined look.

settings.title: About Maria
settings.text:
Maria Tsiatsiani

Choreographer | Dancer | Artistic Director

Maria Tsiatsiani is an award-winning Argentine Tango dancer, choreographer, and judge for the World Tango Championships. She’s performed in over 50 countries, choreographed more than 10 London West End shows, and is known for her powerful stage presence and artistic precision. Resident choreographer for the BBC’s Strictly Come Dancing (the UK’s version of Dancing with the Stars) and a TV personality regular on British television; Maria shares the beauty of Tango with millions. She also co-directs London Tango Academy—voted Best Tango School worldwide (2018–19) and Best UK Dance School (2023–24). Now a Bloch Ambassador, she meticulously helped guide the design for the new line of Argentine Tango shoes. On stage, on screen, or in class—Maria’s passion is to inspire connection through the art of dance.
